name: w18-odd-llm-checklist
kind: documentation hygiene checklist for LLM-driven agent-based models (method sketch)
source: block names follow arXiv 2611.08932; every item id, field and question below is this sketch's own wording and numbering
placeholder_rule: a field counts as documented only if its value is a number, a non-empty list or object, or a string that is non-empty after trimming and is not one of the placeholder words (compared case-insensitively, trailing dots and spaces ignored); a missing key or null is missing; booleans count as documented

items.asks: What the agent keeps from one step to the next, and in what shape.
How stored items are picked back up for a prompt, including how many.
The moves an agent can make in the world, listed.
If agents talk, who can read what is said.
Where each persona's text came from (written by hand, sampled, generated).
The exact persona text as sent, or a pointer to the file that holds it.
How personas differ between agents in one run.
Whether a persona stays fixed during a run, and if not, what changes it.
The exact model name and dated version string used for agent turns.
Sampling settings by name and value, e.g. temperature and token cap.
The seed used, or a plain note that the service gives no seed control.
Which hosted service was called and on what dates.
The unchanging instruction text for the main call, word for word.
Whose voice the model answers in, e.g. narrator watching the game vs a participant in it.
How a raw reply is turned into an in-world move.
What happens when a reply cannot be used: how many re-asks, then what.
How older history is cut or shortened before it goes into a prompt.
The real-world or published pattern the runs are checked against.
How many independent runs were made for each setting.
How run-to-run spread is shown, and over which unit.
Whether prompt wording was varied to see if outcomes move.
A comparison run with no language model in the loop, if any.
